source_name: EFFIS / Copernicus Fire Weather Index forecast
text: EFFIS Fire Weather Index peaks at 27.7 — 'high' on the EFFIS scale — at Araia (stage 3) on 2026-11-08, across a 3-day forecast from 2026-11-06. 6 stage endpoint(s) reach 'high' (>= 21.3) or worse: Araia (stage 3) 28, Navarrete (stage 7) 27, Alcanadre (stage 9) 26, Logroño (stage 8) 26, Calahorra (stage 10) 25, Alda (stage 4) 24. FWI anomaly at Araia is +11.6 versus the seasonal norm. Reported because: changed. Classes: low <11.2, moderate 11.2-21.3, high 21.3-38, very high 38-50, extreme 50-70, very extreme >70.
